notes.title: Highwater Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
Highwater launches this Spring and we at Demagog Studios are excited to take you on an atmospheric adventure through Alphaville and beyond. 

[b]Join us on 2/7 at 10 am PST/1 pm EST/8:00  pm CEST [/b]as we show off some exclusive gameplay of this story-driven adventure with a unique turn-based tactical combat system that incorporates both strategy and puzzle-solving mechanics. 

We will be chatting about the development, level design, music, and visual composition. So ready your boats, tune into Highwater Pirate Radio and prep those questions. 

Earth may be flooded, but there's always time to enjoy the view. 

[b]Be sure to play the demo during Next Fest and Wishlist Highwater today! [/b]
